items.title: Calumet Coatings adds a second shift on the powder line in Hammond
items.snippet: Calumet Coatings is adding a night shift on its powder coating line, citing batch changeover time as the limiting factor on throughput.

items.title: Calumet Coatings is hiring: Production Scheduler
items.snippet: Calumet Coatings posted an opening for a Production Scheduler to coordinate batch sequencing across coating lines.
